headline: Default InfoBufferSize built with MustParse instead of NewQuantity plus String()
reason: Same zero DecimalSI value; MustParse now caches the string, replacing the manual String() call that no longer caches.
summary: The recommended-routing default for InfoBufferSize is now resource.MustParse("0"), which caches the canonical string. This replaces the explicit String() call that stopped caching once String() became non-mutating. The resulting value is equivalent (0, DecimalSI, s="0"), so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
